title: ENDPOINT LIVENESS AUDIT: the P1.2/P9 closure is a GENUINE squeeze-contradiction (not a dead form); the 6-wire tuple's joint unsatisfiability is the engine, proven independently Mathlib-only (ProbeMargin6, green); ALSO s31z2 dps-20 LANDED at 5e8G (logzeta = +1.7289704098, peak 92.6 GB) - precision spread dps15=+2.9370 vs dps20=+1.7290 is itself a datum
body: CONTEXT: after the 0088 Q-contract retyping, an audit question was posed - is the endpoint's closure engine (P12Uniform.p1_2 -> Closure.p9_closure_rh_of_margin, the stack the LIVE RHEnd.rh_program78 routes through, via S4A.rh_from_regime_closures) itself a dead form?  VERDICT: NO - it is a genuine squeeze-contradiction.  THE MECHANISM (verified in the green tree): p9_closure_rh_of_margin assumes, by_contra, an off-line zero exists; takes the MINIMUM-height off-pair (p9_min_offline_height, counting-free over the B0 HNR/HCJ/HFIN interface); the wire hypothesis (hmargin) at that pair materializes the 6-tuple (Q, dev, flo, Mf, Bfloor, Mr) = (Qside, devOf, flo, Mf, Bwire, Mr) evaluated at the pair (squeeze_gives_margin is a pure existential packaging - the four legs ARE the four conjuncts); and p9_point_contradiction closes: from Q >= dev - Mf and dev >= flo one gets flo - Mf <= Q, while from Q <= Bfloor + Mr and Bfloor + Mr + Mf < flo one gets Q < flo - Mf, hence False.  THE DISTINCTION FROM THE 0088 DEAD FORM (recorded so it is never re-confused): in the DEAD form the contradiction sat INSIDE ONE LEG - S3 = 'for all (Q : R), Q <= Bwire + Mr' was unsatisfiable for ANY finite wire, independent of every other leg and of any off-pair, so no data could ever satisfy it (a pure tautological premise; the retyped spine's S3 is now the checkable wire inequality Qside <= Bwire + Mr).  In the LIVE squeeze the contradiction is JOINT across four separately checkable legs (hs1 zero side, hs2 floor dominance, hs3 definition side, hs4 the squeeze), and it arises ONLY at a pair where an off-pair actually exists - which is exactly the engine's job: the data-supported wire faces (the named residual: hs1, hs3, hWin, hS2low) are checkable per-leg, and their joint unsatisfiability at a hypothetical off-pair is what excludes off-pairs, i.e. gives RH.  INDEPENDENT CROSS-CHECK: ProbeMargin6.lean (new, Mathlib-only import, no RhAttack dependency) re-proves the algebraic core as margin6_unsat : NOT (Q >= dev - Mf AND dev >= flo AND Q <= Bf + Mr AND Bf + Mr + Mf < flo) for all real values - confirming the squeeze arithmetic rests on no RhAttack definition.  Full tree build green 17450 with the probe.  DATA (s31z2 ladder, 5e8G, t = 1.5000523e19): dps-20 LANDED - logzeta = +1.7289704098 (4506.3 s, peak 92.6 GB, fresh process).  PRECISION SPREAD AS datum: dps-15 gave +2.9370199551 vs dps-20 +1.7289704098 - a spread of ~1.2 in log|zeta| (a |zeta| factor of ~3.3) between the two precisions at ONE height; the working channel stays dps-40 (the census channel) and the dps-30 cross lands next; the spread itself records that log|zeta| at 1.5e19 is precision-sensitive at the dps-15 level (cancellation in the N = 1.55e9-term sum eats digits), which is why the 5e8G row cannot be certified below dps-40 on this protocol.  dps-30 is running now; dps-40 last.  No RH claim: the liveness audit changes nothing about the named residual; it confirms the engine that consumes it is sound.
